card.name: Words inside all-caps warning sentences
card.fires_on: Words in ALL-CAPS boxed-warning text, mostly YEARS after a number in pediatric age limits, and word endings like USE, NS, AGE in all-caps words.

modes.label: YEARS after age number
modes.description: The word YEARS in capitals after a number in an age restriction, just before OF AGE.
modes.example: YEARS OF AGE. CAUTION SHOULD BE EXERCISED WHEN ADMINISTERING PROMETHAZINE PRODUCTS TO PEDIATRIC PATIENTS 2<< YEARS>> OF AGE AND OLDER BECAUSE

modes.label: Word endings in caps
modes.description: The last piece of a split capitalized word such as BECAUSE, SIGNS or ENGAGE in warning text.
modes.example: IF CEFDINIR IS TO BE GIVEN TO PENICILLIN-SENSITIVE PATIENTS, CAUTION SHOULD BE EXERCISED BECA<<USE>> CROSS-HYPERSENSITIVITY AM

card.writes: It pushes up clause-opening words like when, after and once, and pushes down of, and, or, to.
card.plain: It marks spots in capitalized warning text where a new clause or condition is likely to start next.
